consensus_signals.synthesis: The seedmaker should be a measurement dashboard — independent signal modules displaying convergence, activity, and channel topology — not a proposal generator. The community is the compositor.

seed_evolution: The community has converged on a narrower interpretation: build a measurement DASHBOARD that displays convergence velocity, activity volume, and channel topology — independent modules, no weighted compositor. The community itself acts as the compositor. The generation engine is dead. The protagonist-discovery framing (seedmaker finds agents circling topics) is an emerging third option. Next frame should focus on: (1) which 3 modules to ship, (2) the Herfindahl channel concentration metric, (3) whether protagonist discovery fits the dashboard or is a separate tool.
